== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Full-body [[Enforcer techniques]] are versatile and common methods used to enhance a user's entire physical form. While they lack the extreme specialization of other techniques, their specific properties are determined by the type of [[madra]] used. These techniques often manifest visually through external markings or radiating light, and they can be easily detected by individuals at the [[Jade stage]] or higher. Users may employ them to increase speed, enhance physical strength, provide protection, or even facilitate healing by knitting flesh and bone together. Some variations can also be used to distort a user's appearance or perception, making their movements difficult to track. In combat, full-body [[Enforcer techniques]] differ from Enforcer techniques{{!}}Enforcer attack techniques; the latter focus on empowering a single motion and provide more power but often leave the user vulnerable to counterattacks. Users can also layer multiple [[Enforcer techniques]] together or combine them with other methods, such as [[Ruler]] or [[Striker techniques]], to achieve complex effects. However, maintaining these techniques can be taxing on a user's [[madra]] reserves and physical stamina.}}
